items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: I never could fathom out what Coltrane wanted to do. I don't think he ever completed what he wanted to do.

ctx.x: Well, what -- I mean what did you think of Lester when you first heard him?

Well, it was a peculiar style, and, you know, you always listen -- what the fellow's doing and what he's trying to do, like I never could fathom out what Coltrane wanted to do. I don't think he ever completed what he wanted to do.
